quest.title: Colors Out of Space
quest.description: A strange phenomenon occurred in the Nothing Passage at the northern end of Lempo Isle...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

talks.objective: Follow the light orb to your destination
Find a way to leave the mysterious space

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Waaah, there you are, {NICKNAME}! When those two glowing things crashed into each other, the explosion sent Paimon flying! It's a good thing she didn't get hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It took Paimon forever to fly back here... Paimon's just glad you're okay!

choices.text: Actually, I went flying for a while too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon under— Huh? Wait, what do you mean by flying?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Paimon what you just saw...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm, Paimon's never heard about a place like that in Teyvat... Are you sure you weren't just seeing things, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, as long as you're okay, that's all that matters! There's just way too much weird stuff going on around here. Let's leave this place before it's too late...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, Paimon didn't think they'd be that dangerous, and we didn't even find any treasure in the end... Why would something like that show up here, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if those two glowing things weren't Seelies... then what were they?

choices.text: I think I was blown off to some strange place...
